artboards.title: The way in: today vs after

annotations.text:
Start here — this artboard is live.

Setup's answer is a list, and the list is an allowlist: the sign-in screen offers exactly what is on it. The compiled-in broker is already a way in. Pick a preset, fill an issuer and a client id, and Add — a provider you configure IS the identity service (ADR 0078), with nothing of ours behind it. Bin any row to take it away; empty the list to see what a deployment with no accounts says.

The complaint, and the answer.

Left is what shipped: an amber wall the reader cannot act on, above an Unlock tab. Right is after setup — the notice is gone, Unlock is withheld while there is no sealed vault to open, and the provider the deployment signs people in with reads along the foot.

How setup is navigated on a phone.

A was built while setup asked four questions, and outgrown when it asked one: a progress rail over a single step is furniture. B is drawn because it is the app's existing ceremony vocabulary and deserved a fair hearing — its cost is that the finishing action moves whenever a row opens, which is exactly the mobile complaint.
